mentions.name: Simon
mentions.description: A single-binary, dependency-free system monitor written in Rust that provides metrics, Docker monitoring, alerts, and file browsing while maintaining a minimal footprint suitable for embedded systems and other constrained hardware.
mentions.problem: Most monitoring tools are complex and have high overhead.
mentions.audience: People monitoring embedded systems and other constrained hardware
mentions.source_excerpt:
Frustrated by the complexity and high overhead of most monitoring tools, I wrote Simon.

It’s a single binary, dependency-free monitor in Rust that does it all: metrics, Docker, alerts, and file browsing. While maintaining a minimal footprint for embedded systems and other constrained hardware.
